Definition: from G1537 and G393; to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate:--spring up.
BiblicalUsage: exanatéllō is a plain word for spring up. In Mark 4:5, the text says "And some fell on stony ground."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, exanatéllō means spring up, and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Growth; Nature and Creation; Word of God
